claims.summary: Let char(k)!=2, c>=m>=1, r>=0 and g in k[tau] have degree m. For x=sqrt(1+epsilon*tau), the full-series saturated limit of g*F_c+x^(2r+1)*F_c is F_(m-1)+g*span{tau^e:e in E}, where E is the order set at x=1 of span{x^(2j):0<=j<=c}+span{x^(2r+1+2j):0<=j<=c-m}. The sum is direct of dimension 2c+2.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer, including the genericity clarification. Polynomial division splits the exact source; an order-echelon basis gives the residual monomial limit; reductions are independent modulo g, proving full saturation.
claims.rationale: Preserves finite even cuts in the next actual confluence, instead of replacing their exceptional polynomial profiles by consecutive blocks.
claims.next_action: Use the retained residual order sets in coupled marked maps and their smoothing, without assuming consecutive limits.

claims.summary: For d>=5, c=8d-17, define integer binomial determinants DA=(4/45)c(c-1)(2c-3)(2c+1)(2c-1)^2 and DB=(2/45)c(2c-3)(2c+3)(2c-1)^2(2c+1)^2. If both are nonzero modulo an odd prime p, the original generic V_(7,d) is Hasse-normal. This includes all p>16d-31 and characteristic zero. At p=3,5 reduce the integer determinants, not the rational expressions. Failure of the unit criterion is not asserted to be nonnormality.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer, including the genericity clarification. The actual fourth-merge blocks become F_(2c+1) when the last-column determinants are units; the universal ordinary five-condition conic identity proves normality. The only uncovered p3 case of that identity forces DB divisible by three and is excluded by hypothesis.
claims.rationale: Settles the exact ordinary-profile range and isolates the arithmetic cases where the full exceptional profiles must be retained.
claims.next_action: Repair the proven exceptional ternary boundary family in the elliptic source; do not sweep larger degrees of already-covered unit classes.

claims.summary: In characteristic three, for every d>=5 with d=5 mod27, the full fourth-merge rational boundary of the dimension-seven three-pair series has generic length-N Hasse corank exactly one, N=64d-128. With c=8d-17 and a=2c-1, its polynomial blocks are A=F_a+v^2*w^4*span(tau^a,tau^(a+1)) and B=F_(a-1)+w^4*span(tau^a,tau^(a+1),tau^(a+2)), and source v*A+w^3*A+v^2*B+v*w^3*B. This refutes this universal boundary certificate, not original V_(7,d) normality.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer, including the genericity clarification. Lucas pivots give the full profiles. Thirteen exact conic constraints have a fixed matrix across the whole congruence class: its determinant is identically zero over F3(u)[C,X,Y]. A verified cofactor has q1=C*X/u^3+C^2 R with coefficient u-valuations>=-12; after C=u^N and the actual X,Y substitutions its leading term is nonzero, proving exact corank one uniformly.
claims.rationale: Finds an infinite-family obstruction on the critical sufficient route and identifies the single missing direction that an elliptic smoothing or different degeneration must recover.
claims.next_action: Determine a nonzero first smoothing coefficient for the boundary kernel/cokernel pair on the actual elliptic 32-condition map, uniformly for d=5 mod27.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.mathematical_status: Dimension seven, d>=5, now has the exact DA/DB unit classes, including p>16d-31. The fourth rational boundary fails for d=5 mod27 in characteristic three, which does not refute the original conjecture.

lem:cube-seven-paired-criterion.mathematical_status: The elliptic criterion remains valid. Its derived fourth rational boundary has generic corank one on an infinite ternary family, so that boundary cannot replace the unproved elliptic nonvanishing.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=7 small-prime range outside proved subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not two for n<=6 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands. At n=7,d>=5 the exact DA/DB conic unit classes are proved, including p>16d-31. The fourth rational boundary has generic corank one for p=3,d=5 mod27; this is not failure of the original series. Degree-one orders retain the separate Catalan law. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable thresholds.
